rule: Only open datasets listed below may be used. NASA sources first. No dataset, mission, model weights or service produced by or associated with China. No pretrained third-party ML weights.

datasets.name: SPHEREx DR1 Level 2 spectral images (and QR3)
datasets.licence: Public domain (NASA data policy); cite DOI 10.26131/IRSA652 (QR2) and the DR1 DOI
datasets.used_for: search images, flags, variance, PSF, per-pixel wavelength

datasets.name: JPL Horizons ephemeris API
datasets.used_for: SPHEREx spacecraft (-163182) and Earth heliocentric positions at each exposure

datasets.name: JPL Small-Body Identification API
datasets.used_for: known asteroids and comets in each patch

datasets.name: Planet Nine reference population, Version 3.0 (Brown 2023)
datasets.used_for: 100,000 synthetic Planet Nine orbits with ZTF/DES/PS1 exclusion flags

datasets.name: IRSA ObsTAP (ivoa.obscore) collection discovery
datasets.used_for: discovering which SPHEREx collections IRSA currently publishes (spherex_dr1, spherex_qr3, ...) so the Sky Viewer picks up a new data release with no code change
datasets.verified: 2026-11-14 returns spherex_dr1, spherex_dr1_cal, spherex_dr1_cube, spherex_dr1_deep, spherex_qr3, spherex_qr3_deep

datasets.name: CDS Sesame name resolver (SIMBAD / NED / VizieR)
datasets.owner: Centre de Donnees astronomiques de Strasbourg (CNRS / Universite de Strasbourg)
datasets.licence: Free for research and education (CDS terms of use)
datasets.used_for: resolving an object name typed by the user into RA/Dec. Optional: the five challenge test targets and a built-in catalogue resolve offline with no network call. CDS is the author of the Aladin tool the challenge brief recommends; it is not a Chinese source, so the project rule is satisfied.
